_comment: Inference profiles — the request-time half of requirement j ('the most adequate LLM for each task, low token consumption, accuracy preserved'). governance/MODEL_ROUTING.md picks WHICH model runs an agent; this file sets HOW it runs: sampling determinism, reasoning effort, output ceilings and retrieval width. Applied by scripts/inference_profiles.py at agent-save time (create_agents.py, create_delivery_agents.py, apply_advisory_profile.py, create_orchestrator.py) and at request time (_foundry_runtime.Runtime.ask). Changing a profile is a Tier-B change (operations/CHANGE_MANAGEMENT.md): re-run the golden set before it serves traffic, because every value here can move accuracy as well as cost.
_model_families: A parameter is legal per MODEL FAMILY, not per tier. o-series reasoning models reject temperature/top_p and take reasoning_effort instead; the gpt-4o family is the reverse. inference_profiles.py drops nothing silently: an illegal parameter for the resolved model is an error, so a tier switch cannot quietly change how an agent samples.

o-series._note: Reasoning models sample at a fixed temperature; sending temperature/top_p is rejected by the service. Effort is the lever: 'low' ends the reasoning pass sooner (fewer reasoning tokens, lower latency), 'high' spends more of it.

_classes: Six behavioural classes. The class — not the tier — decides the parameters, so an agent keeps its settings when its tier model changes.

router.purpose: Menu routing and hand-off only; emits a ROUTE line or a short menu.

file-transform.purpose: Deterministic transformation into a fixed schema or a rendered file; the template carries the quality.

report.purpose: Templated deliverables (DPIA, CISO decks, TPRM slides, Form B drafts) against verified extraction rules.

analysis.purpose: Evidence, SOC, pentest, OSINT and scoring work — every number traceable, every finding sourced.

advisory.purpose: User-facing framework and TPRM advice (requirements g/h/i). Quality of reasoning IS the product.

verifier.purpose: Deterministic rule check emitting VERDICT: PASS|FAIL plus reasons. Must never rewrite the deliverable.

_agent_class: Explicit per agent — no heuristic. An agent absent here fails scripts/inference_profiles.py --check, so a newly created agent cannot ship without a deliberate class.
_overrides: Per-agent deviations from the class, each with the reason it exists. Anything not named here takes the class value unchanged.

tpsrca-calc._reason: Emits the calculation_engine.py result block only — scores, weights and the audit trail. The wide analysis ceiling would only buy prose the renderer discards.

pdf-full-coverage-analyzer._reason: Full-coverage chunking must not lose a passage to a retrieval cut-off; recall outranks token economy for this agent by charter.

template-manager._reason: Template edits are shown to the approver as a visual before/after diff. Any sampling variance reads as an unexplained change in the review.

learn._reason: Explanatory answers, not deliverables; the advisory ceiling is four times what any teaching answer needs.

_caching: Prompt caching is free efficiency when the prefix is stable. Rules enforced by scripts/tests/test_inference_profiles.py: (1) agent instructions carry the persona and the charter ONLY — never a date, run id, supplier name or any per-run value, which would break the prefix on every call; (2) the persona block is assembled FIRST so the long static prefix is shared across every agent sharing it; (3) volatile content travels in the user message. Hit rate is measured by operations/kql/prompt-cache-hit-rate.kql and reviewed monthly with the tier-tuning loop (governance/MODEL_ROUTING.md §Token-economy rules 7).
_accuracy_floor: None of these values may be relaxed to save tokens on an agent whose output is a report of record. max_output_tokens is a runaway guard sized from the deliverable's JSON schema, not a budget: a truncated response is a FAIL at the verifier, never a shipped deliverable. If an agent truncates, raise the ceiling and investigate the prompt — do not lower the schema.
